info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Webhook Endpoint Test-spec
info.description: The Webhook Test API allows users to validate the functionality of their webhook endpoints within the microservice environment. This endpoint is specifically designed for testing purposes, enabling developers to send test notifications to their configured webhook URL and verify the correct handling of incoming requests. It is particularly useful for consumers setting up integrations or automating workflows, ensuring that notifications are correctly processed before going live. By utilizing this API, teams can effectively troubleshoot any issues with webhook integrations.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to test the functionality of the webhook associated with the resource ID RES-100045. Use this to ensure that the webhook is set up correctly and is responding as expected.
